about: v270 job L (docs/V270-MAC-JOBS-RECORD.md): DI-1's long-context quality gate. 8,192 tokens prefilled in 4,096-token calls, 192 teacher-forced steps a text; the noise arm changes only the call size; di1 runs every call encoder-only and the decoder half once at the end. No battery: its prompts are single-call.
